{{SameName|Present2|'''Cold Ambush''' • [[Present2 (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus Frosthold]]}} {{EventEnded|date = 4th of February 2023|event = [[Violent Night Event]]}} {{For|[[Breaker2]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Present2 |image1 = Present2.png |mode_appearance = [[Violent Night Event|Violent Night]] |first_wave_appearance = ???/❄️ |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]40 |shield_hp = [[File:ShieldHealth.png|20px|Shield Health]]60 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4) |spawned_by = [[Present3 (Cold Ambush)|Present3]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Holiday Gift}}''' - Upon death, spawns [[Present (Cold Ambush)|Present]]. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Present2''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It first naturally spawned on Wave ???/❄️, but it could appear earlier as three of them were spawned by the [[Present3 (Cold Ambush)|Present3]] upon death. It had a decent amount of health and an above average speed. Upon death, it would spawn one [[Present (Cold Ambush)|Present]], which had lower health and shield health. These also did not spawn anything upon death. This would create huge hordes of enemies, which could easily overwhelm unprepared players. ==Appearance== The '''Present2''' was a humanoid present. The wrapping paper was a pattern of white dots equally distanced from each other, with a green background behind them. There was a white ribbon going across its head and torso, as well as a big white bow on its chest. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]], [[Golden Minigunner]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. *The [[Commander]] can be quite useful at decreasing the firerate of these towers. **The [[DJ Booth]] can also be helpful by increasing the range of your towers and decreasing the upgrade costs of them. *As the '''Present2''' can create hordes of [[Present (Cold Ambush)|Present]]s, towers that can deal damage to multiple enemies, such as the [[Executioner]] or [[Engineer]], can do pretty well against this. ==Trivia== *The '''Present2''' was very similar to the breaker enemies, specifically the [[Breaker2]]. *Due to the [[Present3 (Cold Ambush)|Present3]], the '''Present2''' could spawn before its debut wave. **Additionally, the '''Present2''' could also make the [[Present (Cold Ambush)|Present]] spawn before its debut wave. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Present2''' added. *'''4 February 2023''' - [[v1.6.1]] **'''Present2''' removed. {{ColdAmbush2|[[Papa Bread (Cold Ambush)|Papa Bread]]
